problemSolution.title: Why Health Tracking in India Needs a Re-imagining
problemSolution.description: Most fitness apps are designed for Western meals, kitchen scales, and solitary tracking. FitKarma is built from the ground up for how Indian households actually live, eat, and stay healthy.
traditionalItems: Databases dominated by foreign foods, lacking regional Indian preparations
Rigid gram measurements that don't fit household katoris, rotis, or shared pots
Overwhelming raw data charts without practical daily next steps
Isolated single-user accounts with zero awareness of family health care
fitkarmaItems: 500+ seeded regional recipes, Indian home cooking, street food, and festival specialties
Familiar household portion units (katori, roti count, spoon, piece, and family recipe splitter)
Daily Intelligence Package (DIP) highlighting the single most meaningful next step
Consent-first family care dashboard designed for real Indian household support

privacySection.title: Your Health Data Belongs to You
privacySection.description: FitKarma is designed on privacy-by-design principles. We collect only what is strictly required for the beta programme, and we never sell your personal information.

pillars.title: Data Minimisation
pillars.desc: Our beta signup collects only your name, email, and feature priorities. No medical history, diagnosis, weight, or phone numbers.

pillars.title: Affirmative Consent
pillars.desc: Clear terms with explicit, un-ticked marketing checkboxes. You are never forced to accept promotional emails to join the beta.

pillars.title: India DPDP Alignment
pillars.desc: Engineered around the data fiduciary and grievance principles of India's Digital Personal Data Protection regulatory framework.

pillars.title: Clear Medical Boundaries
pillars.desc: FitKarma is an intelligent wellness and fitness assistant. It does not provide medical diagnoses, treatment advice, or emergency clinical care.

betaSection.heading: Be part of the first 1,000.
betaSection.body: Join the FitKarma beta programme and help shape an India-first health and wellness experience. Phase 1 places are allocated first-come, first-served after email verification. Once the 1,000 places are filled, new verified applicants can join the Phase 2 waitlist.

items.a: FitKarma is India's AI-powered Fitness and Wellness Ecosystem. It brings Indian nutrition, movement, recovery, and family-aware wellness together into one personal, intelligent experience.

items.q: Who can apply for the beta?
items.a: Anyone in India interested in an India-first approach to health and wellness can apply. Tier-1 professionals, college students, home cooks, and families managing household health are all welcome.

items.q: How are the first 1,000 places allocated?
items.a: Places are allocated strictly first-come, first-served in the order that applicants successfully verify their email address via our atomic database transaction. An unverified submission does not hold a seat.

items.q: What happens when Phase 1 is full?
items.a: Once all 1,000 Phase 1 places have been allocated to verified participants, subsequent verified applicants are automatically placed on the Phase 2 waitlist.

items.q: Do I need to pay to apply for the beta?
items.a: No. Applying for and participating in the Phase 1 beta programme is completely free. Commercial subscription plans (such as Yogi Free and Karma Pro) will only be introduced in subsequent stages.
The FitKarma mobile application is built for Android and iOS devices. You can indicate your preferred device platform during the registration step.

items.q: Will every feature be available on the first day?
items.a: No. The entire documented feature inventory is part of the beta programme, but capabilities will be rolled out progressively in staged releases to ensure stability, accuracy, and user safety.
Email is our only communication channel. We will never send you unsolicited WhatsApp messages, SMS messages, or phone calls regarding your beta application.

items.q: What information do you collect during registration?
items.a: We practice strict data minimisation: we only collect your name, email address, primary feature interest, and optional platform/language preference. We do not collect phone numbers, health metrics, or medical data.

items.q: How can I withdraw my application or request deletion?
items.a: You can withdraw your application or request deletion of your information at any time by contacting our support team at sulekhniwal@gmail.com.

No. FitKarma is a fitness, nutrition, and wellness intelligence assistant. It is not a clinical service, does not diagnose or treat medical conditions, and should not replace advice from certified healthcare professionals.
